QEH15CA square block ZA medium preload accuracy class P with E2 lubrication unit
column3: block width 34 mm; installation height 24 mm; block length 56.8 mm; 2 x M4 x 6 mounting threads 26 mm apart across the block; Cdyn 12530 N and C0 15280 N for the standard block (lower with the E2 unit)
column10: Downloaded as QEH15CAZAP_E2_FILE_1.stp. ZA = medium preload; P = precision class. The E2 lifetime lubrication unit sits on one end and takes the place of one hole row; so the block has 2 mounting holes instead of the 4 in the catalogue; and less load capacity (confirmed by Niels Bosmans; the reduced load ratings are not known). The hole row is at the centre of the block body; 6.55 mm off the centre of the whole block.
